I have been farming maize here in Ruvuma for many years, and with nearly two hectares of land, I need to get a decent harvest to feed my family and have some surplus to sell. The soil has become tired, so I will buy a few bags of urea and DAP from the market to give the crop a boost, though I cannot afford the recommended amount. I will plant the maize seed I saved from last season because the improved varieties are too expensive, and I do not trust them as much as my own seed. This plot is large, so my wife and children will spend many days working here, but I will hire a few laborers for about a month to help with land clearing and weeding when the rains begin.
